artists.name: A-GEOFFREY
artists.summary: A-GEOFFREY brings high-energy psychedelic trance shaped by full-on, funky and twisted sounds, built for both day and night dancefloors.
bio: Geoffrey Smith, known behind the decks as A-GEOFFREY, has been active in the electronic music scene since the early 2000s and performing under this name for more than a decade. He is signed to Cape Town label State Alchemy Music.
His driving psychedelic sets move through full-on, funky, twisted and intelligent sounds. Equally at home in day and night slots, A-GEOFFREY is known for high energy and mind-bending soundscapes.

artists.name: Almost a Sin
artists.summary: Almost a Sin is Zenn Viljoen's live looping project, crossing the boundary between musician and DJ.
bio: Zenn Viljoen builds Almost a Sin in real time. Parts are played, captured and layered on stage until a full arrangement stands where a single instrument started, which means no two performances resolve the same way.
It is a set that sits deliberately between two worlds: the hands of a live musician and the flow of a DJ reading a room.
artists.image_alt: Portrait of Zenn Viljoen of Almost a Sin

artists.name: AMORAIM
artists.summary: AMORAIM is a South African electronic music veteran whose sets range from ambient and dub to high-energy psychedelic sound.
bio: He began making recordings at around 10 years old and released an early African ambient space music project in 1985. His first dub and reggae DJ set followed at The Base in 1988, and he released 20 titles between 1985 and 1995.

From 1997 to 1999, AMORAIM was a resident psychedelic DJ at the original Getafix. In 2001 he released Africa in Trance, described as South Africa's first psytrance CD, and helped bring Skazi to South Africa under Transgression.

Across more than 400 sets, his music has ranged from ambient to 177 BPM dark psy, with 170 titles released through Microdot Records. His next 145–150 BPM psychedelic release is planned for Earthdance 2026.

artists.name: Arcane & Pixie
artists.summary: Arcane & Pixie are a sibling duo raised on South Africa's psytrance culture, delivering a chemistry that only family can bring.
bio: Arcane & Pixie bring a unique sibling connection to the dancefloor, forged through a lifetime immersed in South Africa's psytrance culture. Raised on festivals, outdoor gatherings, and the sounds that shaped a generation, both developed a deep passion for music from an early age.

Their back-to-back performances blend uplifting melodies, driving rhythms, psychedelic textures and infectious bounce into a seamless dancefloor experience. United by family, friendship and a shared love for psytrance, they deliver an authentic energy that can only come from growing up together.
artists.image_alt: Arcane and Pixie together at the decks

members.name: Arcane
members.bio: Raised on the pulse of psytrance since childhood, Arcane specialises in off-beat and full-on psytrance — driving basslines, intelligent psychedelic leads and infectious bounce.

members.name: Pixie
members.bio: Immersed in South Africa's trance scene from a young age, Pixie blends uplifting melodies with bouncy, driving beats drawn from years of musical exploration.

artists.name: Asterion
artists.summary: DJ Asterion. Sound engineer turned storyteller. Hypnotic grooves, soaring synths and moments that move the dancefloor.
bio: Every set is a new chapter.

artists.name: AurallaurA
artists.summary: AurallaurA is an audiophile-turned-DJ who moves playfully across electronic genres, layering samples, hidden messages and driving basslines.
bio: AurallaurA is both palindromic and rhythmical: aural, of the ear, to listen. Listening is precisely what Laura Baasch has been doing with electronic music for 25 years — an audiophile first and a DJ second.
A mischievous selector who is not afraid to flirt across genres, she works with samples, hidden messages and layers, schooling the listener in electronic flavours like a modern Pied Piper.
Her sets carry a playful feminine energy, then throw down unexpected gauntlets of thick, driving basslines that have kicked the pants off many a dancefloor.

artists.name: Changa Manga
artists.summary: Changa Manga come in from the intergalactic psybass and chill cosmic swamp, bass-heavy and sometimes gloriously glitchy.
bio: Changa Manga Soundsystem have been bending innocent minds since 2014, delighting the discerning followers of all tunes bass heavy, sometimes glitchy, and reliably upbeat at the downtempo end of things.
Their own promise for the weekend is simple enough: to share the good vibes on a dancefloor near you, whenever they can.
artists.image_alt: Changa Manga Soundsystem portrait and logo

artists.name: Dan Scot
artists.summary: Dan Scot is a psytrance DJ with a passion for music and community, known for energetic performances and a deep connection with his dancefloor.
bio: His music reflects his love for the genre, and for the last 18 years he has kept pushing the boundaries of what is possible with his sets.
Dan Scot takes his dancefloor on a journey through a dystopic wonderland.
artists.image_alt: Dan Scot smiling while performing at a festival

artists.name: DJ Skitzo
artists.summary: A longstanding fixture of South Africa's psytrance scene, DJ Skitzo carries dancefloors from progressive into full-on as the moon rises.
bio: Contributing to the atmosphere and energy of festivals has been a huge part of his life.
Progressive psytrance sits at the heart of his sets, though on the right occasion he draws on his psychedelic full-on collection.
Sunset slots are a particular favourite: a chance to begin with progressive sounds, then let the full-on collection take over as the moon rises.
artists.image_alt: DJ Skitzo performing at a festival

artists.name: DJ Sublime
artists.summary: DJ Sublime doesn't simply play music; she creates an atmosphere where bodies move and strangers become one collective pulse.
bio: Michelle Lobel plays with an instinct for reading the energy of a dancefloor, shaping a room rather than filling it. Bodies move, hearts open, and a crowd of strangers arrives somewhere together.
Expect lush textures, seductive rhythms, unexpected moments and a steadily rising invitation to let go.
artists.image_alt: Portrait of DJ Sublime behind carved festival stage art

artists.name: Django
artists.summary: Django is a Cape Town DJ, producer and percussionist whose work moves between eclectic DJ sets, live electronic performance and original releases.
bio: Django Flaherty has performed in live electronic acts including Pravda and Ward 10 & The Outpatients at festivals such as Vortex, Origin and Freaky Forest.

He has been behind the decks since 2006 and releasing original electronic music as DjangoZa since 2018. His releases include tracks on Do Work and Ambious, as well as collaborations with South African vocalist Tasha Baxter.

artists.name: Firehorse
artists.summary: DJ Firehorse has been playing sacred world music for over 30 years.
bio: Her sets blend mantras and tribal music with a modern beat.

artists.name: Gray Matter
artists.summary: Gray Matter brings modern, contemporary psytrance drawn from a multitude of genres — is this psytrance, or something more?
bio: Graydon Fortuin describes himself as a music maker and alien enthusiast, visiting Planet Earth to bring his own expression of modern, contemporary psytrance.
Inspirations from a multitude of genres surface inside a single psychedelic body of work, which raises the question his sets keep asking: is this psytrance, or is it something more?
artists.image_alt: Portrait of Gray Matter DJing under red light

artists.name: JamDay
artists.summary: Signed to Sonic Tantra / Flying Woofer Records in Goa, JamDay has been contributing to the South African psy and festival tribe since the early 2000s.
bio: With a collection of EPs and a unique recipe of live sets, Oli is known for conjuring cheeky, vibrational magic at sunset and unleashing crushing psychedelic fire at sunrise.
artists.image_alt: JamDay working at a music setup with headphones

artists.name: Jester
artists.summary: A Nordic Alien Music Laboratories label DJ, Jester weaves story-like sets sewn together with seamless mixes fuelled by a relentless energy.
bio: Lester Pywell was introduced to trance in early 2001, in the apple orchards of Elgin. The bug bit, and the rest was history.

He latched onto turntables in the UK around 2002, and upon his return to South Africa in 2004, Jester was born. He and friends began hosting underground events called Electric Garden, and in no time Jester found his way onto all the major nighttime dancefloors around South Africa, quickly recognised and sought after for story-like sets sewn together with seamless mixes fuelled by a relentless energy.

His journey has seen him represent the likes of Peak Records and Mechanik Records. Currently representing Nordic Alien Music Laboratories, Jester's sound has moulded and matured over the years, and he prefers not to be put in a box — keeping it psychedelic remains his one key focus.

artists.name: Kayflow
artists.summary: Kaylee Terblanche teaches yoga in its traditional sense, using simple, intentional movement and breath as our greatest source of strength.
bio: Kaylee Terblanche is a yoga teacher and a student of Ayurveda. After completing her 500-hour teacher training she went further inward, and found the power of connecting with our energy from within.

Her classes begin at the heart, in the space of Anahata, where awareness softens and energy begins to reorganise itself. We create length through the spine. We breathe into places that have been quiet for too long. We allow what is ready to rise to rise.
Nothing forced, nothing performed — just subtle shifts that change everything, focusing less on how we look and more on how we feel.
artists.image_alt: Portrait of Kaylee Terblanche of Kayflow

artists.name: Lolo
artists.summary: Lolo brings melodic liquid and deep-rolling drum & bass, with a careful ear for the underground minimal sound.
bio: Since debuting at Rubricate in 2021, Lolo has steadily built a reputation for carefully curated sets that showcase her love of melodic liquid and deep-rolling drum & bass. As co-founder of the underground DnB collective Liminil, she is committed to sharing the underground minimal sound with fellow enthusiasts.

artists.name: Mac Attack
artists.summary: A father/son duo, Dave Mac and Josh Mac bring a deadly combo of youth and experience to South Africa's psytrance scene.
bio: Father/son duo Dave Mac and Josh Mac, known as Mac Attack, are a deadly combo of youth and experience.
When seasoned psytrance DJ Dave Mac teams up with his son Josh, anything can happen. Their sets are spontaneous and unrehearsed, as they serve up a heady mix of psychedelic groove music.

This unique father/son duo — a first in the South African psytrance scene — is a psy-family affair served with a massive dose of respect for the dancefloor and an appreciation for the incredible psychedelic music they get to play. Expect a scintillating and fresh journey full of energy, sexy psychedelia, positive vibrations and bouncing bass.
Mac Attack are also in the throes of completing an album's worth of original psy cooked up in their studio — coming to a speaker near you.
artists.image_alt: Dave Mac and Josh Mac of Mac Attack

artists.name: Midiclorian
artists.summary: Cape Town DJ Ryan Wallis brings a storyteller's instinct to the dancefloor, blending powerful melodies with driving rhythms.
bio: With over 23 years of music production experience and a background in sound engineering, Ryan has been making waves in the local scene over the last few years.

artists.name: Mikey Dredd
artists.summary: Part of the foundational South African psytrance scene, Mikey Dredd is a seasoned selector whose sonic palette defies easy categorisation.
bio: With over 30 years of experience anchoring the dance music scene, Mikey Dredd is a seasoned selector whose career reflects the evolution of electronic sound itself. A true musical chameleon, his sets are defined by an expansive sonic palette that defies easy categorisation.

Moving fluidly across the spectrum, he navigates seamlessly from the deep, reverberating basslines of dub and the atmospheric grooves of trip-hop and downtempo, to the high-octane energy of drum and bass and the hypnotic, driving rhythms of psytrance.

His approach to the decks is rooted in pure passion and a deep-seated commitment to the dancefloor. Every set is meticulously curated to create an infectious energy, blending “dank” underground tracks with a vibrant, high-spirited vibe designed to keep the crowd moving from the first beat to the last. More than just a DJ set, a performance by Mikey Dredd is an invitation to experience genuine musical joy — a rhythmic celebration crafted by a veteran who lives for the connection between the music and the movement.
artists.image_alt: Portrait of Mikey Dredd wearing headphones and pointing at the camera

artists.name: Nick E Louder
artists.summary: A London-born DJ and producer immersed in electronic music for over three decades, Nick E Louder marks 33 years on the decks with a worldwide tour in 2026.
bio: Nick E Louder is a London-born DJ and producer who has been immersed in electronic music for over three decades. After arriving in South Africa in the early 1990s, he became part of the movement that helped shape the country's evolving electronic dance music scene.
In 2026, Nick celebrates 33 years as a professional DJ and producer with his 33 Years on the Decks worldwide tour, beginning with performances across South Africa before taking the sound overseas.

His current sound is driven by techno, psy-tech and trance, combining rolling basslines, hypnotic grooves, driving percussion, psychedelic textures and relentless four-to-the-floor energy. His sets move between dark, atmospheric techno, rolling psy-tech and powerful melodic and progressive elements, creating an immersive journey designed for the dancefloor.
With an international performance history spanning clubs, festivals and events around the world, Nick brings decades of experience behind the decks together with a modern production-driven sound.

Now signed to two UK record labels, Nick has released several tracks over the past year and is firmly back in the studio, focusing on new techno and psy-tech productions. He is also collaborating with other artists on original material and remixes, continuing to evolve his sound and push his music forward.
artists.image_alt: Portrait of Nick E Louder at the decks

artists.name: NYX.
artists.summary: NYX. doesn't just play sets; she engineers memories, drawing on a 16-year career and a classically trained musical foundation.
bio: With a career spanning sixteen years and a musical foundation built on a BMus degree and classical training, NYX. has spent a lifetime mastering the science of sound.

As founder of NYX Level Productions and creator of the TECHNOTRONYX, OCEANYX and SOULTONYX brands, her influence on the underground scene runs deep. Her journey has spanned corporate environments, festivals and weddings — from the dust of Botswana to the beaches of Egypt and Zanzibar.
Whether mentoring, curating or tearing through a midnight techno set, NYX. remains a purist. No requests.
“Meet me on the dance floor. That’s how you’ll know me.”
artists.image_alt: Portrait of NYX. at the decks

artists.name: Prefix
artists.summary: Prefix reads the room and builds a new journey every time, moving from second-floor grooves to powerful main-floor sets.
bio: Prefix captures the attention of a crowd and holds it. He moves with the dancefloor and builds on what it feeds back, taking listeners on a new journey every time.

For him, psychedelic culture speaks to our place on this planet and the people within it are family. His role is to be a medium for music between source and listener, opening an avenue towards the trance dance experience.
Behind the alias is John Vichos, co-founder of MOOV Festival and a familiar face on dancefloors nationwide.

artists.name: Psyrenex
artists.summary: Psyrenex is a South African progressive psytrance DJ crafting immersive journeys through hypnotic grooves, melodic textures and emotional storytelling.
bio: Every set builds with intention, creating moments of connection, release and collective energy on the dancefloor.

artists.name: Rave Mustaine
artists.summary: Nobody knows exactly who Rave Mustaine is. They just know he's been lurking in the shadows.
bio: A mysterious figure moving through the darker corners of the South African and Mozambican underground, Rave Mustaine brings dark psytech and hypnotic frequencies designed to bend minds and rearrange dancefloors.

He has appeared in places nobody remembers, at hours nobody should have been awake, leaving behind little more than distorted memories and suspiciously heavy basslines. Come find out what happens when Rave Mustaine comes out to play.
artists.image_alt: Rave Mustaine DJing in a skull mask under psychedelic stage lighting

artists.name: SKAM
artists.summary: While deep tech and deep house laid the foundation, SKAM's true passion is exploring new sonic territories.
bio: His productions move through hip hop, techno, dubstep, drum & bass and future jungle. Synthesizers, raw dark basslines, intricate effects and polyrhythms keep listeners locked in and longing for more.
Notable appearances include RAMFEST, FRAT, Sizzled, SA Cocktail Week, Don't Mind The Bass and the Global Annual 420 Party.

artists.name: SOL
artists.summary: SOL plays bright, energetic music chosen for the joy it brings and the way it lifts a dancefloor.
bio: SOL lives for the moment she discovers new music — the kind that hits hard, lifts the room and gets everyone dancing. For her, DJing is not just about mixing tracks; it is about sharing the sound she loves and creating bright, energetic, lasting impressions.

artists.name: Thomas
artists.summary: Thomas is looking forward to playing at Earthdance and being there for the whole experience.
artists.image_alt: Thomas performing in front of psychedelic stage art

artists.name: Tune Raider
artists.summary: A prominent psytrance DJ from South Africa and part of United Beats Records, Tune Raider has driven the scene for over two decades.
bio: Pamm Legg has been a driving force in South African psytrance for more than twenty years. Known for electrifying sets at Alien Safari, Vortex and Earthdance, she has long since become a key figure in the country's psytrance landscape.

Her influence reaches well beyond it, with standout performances at Universo Paralello in Brazil, Hadra Festival in France and Boomtown Fair in the UK. She is currently exploring a new chapter with a high-energy psychedelic full-on set, at home in daytime and nighttime slots alike.
Tight beat mixing, impeccable track selection and an enchanting stage presence keep her connecting deeply with dancefloors wherever she plays.

artists.name: Ty Teknition
artists.summary: Ty Teknition is a Cape Town DJ, producer and co-founder of Umbrella Rave and Kindred, known for a bouncy, driving and intelligent sound.
bio: Tyrone Platt's sets seamlessly blend tech house, progressive house, psy tech and psytrance, with a slight fusion of reggae, dub and broken beats folded into fresh, high-energy underground journeys.

He builds dancefloors where groove, storytelling and connection come first. Through Umbrella Rave and Kindred he helps deliver world-class electronic music experiences while supporting local communities, working with NGOs and purpose-driven events.
His sets are designed to move people spiritually and physically, spark connection and leave a lasting impression.

artists.name: Uncle Frank
artists.summary: Uncle Frank is a Cape Town-based uplifting psychedelic DJ.

artists.name: Zendrix
artists.summary: Somatic therapist, ecstatic dance facilitator and multi-instrumentalist, Zendrix plays live looping ngoni, woodwinds, poetry and mantras.
bio: Hendrik van der Merwe has been part of South African electronic music since the beginning of it. He was a member of Earthlings in 1992 and EarthDreams in 1994, then, as Zendrik, a founder member of Nagual from 1995 to 2000, playing regular live sets at Rustler's Valley, Vortex and Alien Safari.

Collaborations and live sets at the Gwaing River Mouth on the Garden Route followed through the 2000s. From 2014 to 2018 he facilitated ecstatic dance in San Marcos La Laguna, Guatemala, performing with Mose and joining the Tambour Collective and Raga Funk Spaceship.

Zendrix Live has since travelled from Arambol in Goa to Dharamshala, Summer Solstice, SpiritFest and Louvain Burn. The set moves from ambient to dance beats, built live from Ableton with looping ngoni harp, handpan, woodwinds, poetry and mantras, and joined along the way by guest solo artists.
Alongside the music he works as a somatic therapist and teacher, sound healer and ceremony musician.
artists.image_alt: Zendrix playing the ngoni harp at night

artists.name: Verax
artists.summary: Verax brings tasty psy sounds to the bush doof — sexy, funky, dark prog for the dancefloor.
bio: Verax is a music lover and audiophile for all things psy — off-beat, full-on and everything between, with a sound that leans sexy, funky and dark prog.

artists.name: Jamie Jupiter
artists.summary: Jamie Jupiter is a Cape Town singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist — an eclectic sound built on catchy lyrics, warm performances and 20+ years on stage.
bio: Jamie Jupiter's eclectic sound moves between genres with a light touch, catchy lyrics and warm performances. Born and raised in Cape Town in a musical, theatrical household, he began his 20-year career as a percussionist and harmonica player in the city's Observatory music scene, then as guitarist for glam-rock outfit The Honeymoon Suites.

Since releasing his first album A Brighter Life in 2004, he's played African instruments with the Menjaro Project on a world tour, performed in the cabaret show Angels on Horseback, and toured with Korreltjie Kantel, a SAMA-nominated Afrikaans poetry show. He also runs Ubuntu Drum Fun, his own djembe drumming facilitation company.
artists.image_alt: Jamie Jupiter playing guitar on stage

artists.name: The Great Veroni
artists.summary: The Great Veroni threads decades of Earthdance chill-out sets through Africa's history with the festival, from building Peace Camp's Spiritchill space to earning his name from Mikey Dredd and crew.
bio: Vernon Pendlebury has been involved with Earthdance since it first arrived in Africa. He created the Spiritchill space, which grew into Peace Camp, and spent decades weaving tunes for chill-out spaces across many other events — an array of genres from psy ambient dub to eclectic world fusion.

Those chill spaces often hosted the after-parties, and the need for more beats inspired him to play tunes people could actually boogie to. He's played Origin's Beats stage, the early Main stage and Not the Miniscule for many years — where he was dubbed The Great Veroni by Regan and crew, including Mikey Dredd.

artists.name: PsyMantis
artists.summary: PsyMantis brings two decades of underground experience to the decks — driving, filthy, funky Dirty Prog built to read the dancefloor and keep it moving.
bio: With over two decades behind the decks, PsyMantis is a veteran of South Africa's underground electronic music scene. Starting out in the late '90s on vinyl, his journey moved through Jungle, Drum & Bass and Garage before discovering psytrance in the early 2000s — and never looking back.

Known for bringing the dirty, groovy edge of Dirty Prog to Cape Town dancefloors, PsyMantis has played some of South Africa's most iconic gatherings, including Vortex Open Source, Alien Safari Sprung, Phoenix Festival of Fire and Mozamboogy. His sound is driving, filthy, funky and seriously fun — read the dancefloor, find the groove, keep it moving.

artists.name: Psyborg
artists.summary: Psyborg brings high-energy, uplifting psytrance sets built to connect people through music and keep the dancefloor alive.
bio: Psyborg is the alias of Matthew Coert, a South African psytrance DJ with a passion for creating unforgettable musical journeys. He's been behind the decks since he was 16, and his mission is simple: bring high-energy, uplifting sets that connect people through music and keep the dancefloor alive.

artists.name: DJ Craig A
artists.summary: DJ Craig A plays for the love of Goa Trance — psychedelic, prog and full-on sounds from Yellow Sunshine Explosion recordings.
bio: DJ Craig A is a label DJ for Yellow Sunshine Explosion recordings, playing for the love of Goa Trance — psychedelic, prog and full-on.

artists.name: Ward 10 & The Outpatients
artists.summary: Ward 10 & The Outpatients fuse electronic music with acoustic instruments, moving between progressive tribal psy and deep melodic techno.
bio: Ward 10 & The Outpatients is a collaborative project fusing electronic music with acoustic instruments, played live. Their sound ranges from progressive tribal psy to deep melodic techno.
artists.image_alt: Ward 10 & The Outpatients performing live with acoustic and electronic instruments

artists.name: Bush Diva
artists.summary: Soulful with a touch of jazz, Bush Diva is a singer-songwriter and pianist blending raw emotion, jazz influences and musical tastes from various eras.
bio: Soulful with a touch of jazz, Bush Diva is a singer-songwriter and pianist blending raw emotion, jazz influences and musical tastes from various eras. Her shows are in equal parts poignant and comedic.
With her first solo album underway, Bush Diva delivers a mixture of original songs and covers by the artists who've inspired her along the way. Her tagline: you may laugh or cry or both.
artists.image_alt: Bush Diva singing and playing keyboard, smiling

artists.name: Psy-Anomic
artists.summary: Psy-Anomic brings explosive sunrise sets — relentless rolling basslines, twisted grooves and unapologetic psychedelic chaos as night collides with sunrise.
bio: Born from the chaos between darkness and daylight, Psy-Anomic is most at home when the night has reached its limits and the horizon begins to glow. Renowned for explosive sunrise sets, he has unleashed his particular brand of psychedelic madness on dancefloors at Easter Vortex, Origin and Little Forest Festival, among many others.

Psy-Anomic doesn't do predictable. Expect relentless rolling basslines, twisted grooves, sudden left turns and surprises buried deep within the journey — sets that are highly energetic, mischievous and unapologetically psychedelic, constantly building, shifting and pushing the dancefloor somewhere it didn't expect to go.

This is where nighttime chaos collides with sunrise euphoria. As the shadows disappear and the first rays break across the dancefloor, Psy-Anomic turns the final madness of the night into one last beautiful explosion. No rules. No straight lines. Just rolling basslines, sunrise and pure psychedelic chaos.

artists.name: Drifter
artists.summary: Drifter brings 15 years of driving, high-energy psychedelic trance to the decks — built to move you, and to be moved.
bio: It's been a 15-year journey DJing psychedelic trance music for Drifter, real name Brad Briscoe. His selection stays driving, high-energy and unapologetically psychedelic — exactly as it should be.
Expect to move, and be moved.

artists.name: Sledge
artists.summary: Sledge brings brooding, bloodthirsty, minimal techno to the decks — thunderous basslines, provocative vocals and off-beat glitches.
bio: Brooding, bloodthirsty and minimal — Sledge (Jeff Morrell) plays techno built on thunderous basslines, provocative vocals and off-beat glitches. As he puts it, the music is where the beat isn't.
The sound comes from an unlikely mix: classical piano training colliding with a love of heavy metal. Sledge records for Techgnosis Records.

artists.name: Big E
artists.summary: Big E brings emotion, storytelling and musical depth to the decks — DJ sets built on connection, not trends.
bio: Big E's approach to DJing is rooted in a distinct sonic identity, built after years of exploring electronic music across a wide range of genres.

His sets favour emotion, storytelling and musical depth over trends — every selection intentional, blending groove, rhythm and atmosphere into one continuous journey. For Big E, great DJing isn't just about playing music: it's about reading the room, connecting with people, and guiding them through something memorable.
